connector.name: Flarelink by flarelink.dev
connector.registryDescription: Build on the Flarelink stack - Cloudflare auth, D1, and R2 - from your AI coding tools.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace dev.flarelink, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FLARELINK_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Personal API key from dash.flarelink.dev → API keys. Enables the project-management tools; the knowledge & scaffolding tools work without it.
